about_the_game:
The world has fallen, overrun by monsters. Yet, humanity's last hope lies in a mysterious "Apocalypse Cleaning Company"? Command your team of unique anime-style operatives, and carve a path toward the future through this desolate wasteland with purifying firepower and the aesthetics of carnage! This is a hybrid roguelike game that combines intense top-down shooting, Roguelike build customization, and base management—it's time to reassemble the task force and clean up this chaotic world!

The world has been devastated by an alien invasion—civilization has collapsed, and monsters roam freely. The remnants of humanity huddle within their last strongholds, clinging to survival.

In these darkest hours, you unexpectedly take over a mysterious company known as "Apocalypse Cleaning." Your mission is far from ordinary cleanup: lead the company’s special task force into the most dangerous contaminated zones and execute high-risk "purification" missions—eradicating all threats with bullets and flames.

【Core Gameplay Loop】

Every mission is a life-or-death struggle. Select your operatives, equip powerful weapons and skills, and venture into dynamically generated hazardous zones with pre-configured loadouts. Succeed, and you’ll earn valuable resources and new equipment; fail, and you’ll have to start over. But with each battle, you and your company will grow stronger.

【Management & Progression】

Intense combat is only part of the job. You are also the manager of the company: recruit elites, fulfill contracts, develop equipment, and expand facilities. Every decision you make will shape the future of humanity.

Will the world return to order? The answer lies in your bullets and your wisdom.

Wishlist 《异净特遣队 (Purification Front)》now and stay tuned for the moment the purification war begins!
